about.title: About
about.description: Software Engineer with experience in building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications. I specialize in creating seamless frontend experiences and robust backend solutions while solving complex technical challenges. Passionate about clean code, innovative solutions, and continuous learning, I enjoy transforming ideas into efficient, reliable, and user-focused digital products.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skilled in building modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET, and Node.js. Experienced with REST APIs, SQL databases, testing, CI/CD, and Agile development practices to deliver high-quality software.

softwareEngineer.subtitle: Talverse

associateSoftwareEngineer.subtitle: Talverse
associateSoftwareEngineer.description: Optimized frontend performance through lazy loading and code splitting, achieving 85%+ Lighthouse performance scores. Developed modern applications using React, Next.js, and ASP.NET.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.value-victor-description: Honored with Talverse's quarterly Value Victor Award (Q3 2025) for demonstrating ownership, resilience, technical excellence, and leadership while delivering successful project outcomes and solving complex engineering challenges. It was especially meaningful because it reflected the trust my team and company placed in my work.

Strengthened and proved my leadership, communication, and presentation skills through peer collaboration, cross-functional teamwork, and delivering impactful presentations while gaining insights into effective leadership practices.
